# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

We want BERTopic Tuning to be a respectful, evidence-minded place to discuss
semantic-first topic modeling, reproducibility, and the limits of automated
interpretation. Everyone participating in this project is expected to help
make that possible.

## Expected behavior

- Discuss methods, evidence, and implementation choices in good faith.
- Respect different disciplines, languages, identities, lived experiences, and
  levels of technical experience.
- Distinguish a disagreement about a model, metric, or interpretation from a
  judgment about a person.
- Protect research participants and organizations by keeping private or
  sensitive corpora out of public discussions.
- Accept constructive review and correct mistakes when evidence shows they are
  mistakes.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, threats, discrimination, personal attacks, sexualized language,
unwelcome contact, deliberate misrepresentation, and publication of private or
sensitive data are not acceptable. Do not use an issue, pull request, or
discussion to expose corpus text, participant information, credentials, or
other material that should remain confidential.

## Enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately through the repository's
[security advisory form](https://github.com/Roblis0n/Bertopic-tuning/security/advisories/new).
Maintainers will review reports promptly, keep information as confidential as
practicable, and may remove content, warn participants, or restrict
participation when needed to protect the community.
